I found no dated AI prediction by Ilya Sutskever from 2021. But the fixed searches don't support calling it a quiet year, so `quiet_year` is false.

- **Why not quiet:** The rule says a year is quiet only when the fixed searches ran and found no candidate. All three ran once, but they turned up nothing from 2021. They returned 2023–2025 material, mostly coverage of his late-2025 interview with Dwarkesh Patel, where he forecast "5 to 20 years." My own searches and page openings found what's below. They don't show that 2021 held nothing.
- **Scale TransformX fireside chat (posted 6 Oct 2021):** I read the transcript up to 27:55. His only forward-looking timing phrase is "over the next few years." That counts as undated, and it isn't about when AGI arrives, so it doesn't qualify even as an undated item. The transcript page stopped at 27:55, so I couldn't check the later part, including what he said about CLIP and DALL-E around 35:51. Scale's written summary of the chat had no dated forecasts.
- **The Batch, "In 2021, language models will start to become aware of the visual world":** This is a real dated prediction, but the page shows it was published 30 Dec 2020. It belongs to 2020, not 2021.
- **The Robot Brains podcast (25 Aug 2021):** I found only listing pages, not a transcript, so I couldn't check it.
